shortDescription: Create or Delete QoS COS trust modes on AOS-CX.

options.name: code_point
options.description: 3-bit integer value that marks packets with one of eight priority levels, defined as Class of Service Priority Code Point (PCP) in IEEE 802.1Q VLAN tag.

options.name: color
options.description: String to identify the color which may be used later in the pipeline in packet-drop decision points.

options.name: local_priority
options.description: Integer to represent an internal meta-data value that will be associated with the packet. This value will be used later to select the egress queue for the packet.
